name: watch
title: Watch
description: A grid of dim round cells, each holding a small dot. Under the pointer the dots fill their cells, most at the cursor and less with distance, and every dot turns toward it: a field of eyes.
docs: One self-contained file, react only: no Tailwind, no other dependency. Mount <Watch /> inside an element with position: relative and a size; it covers that element and is decoration only: give it no link or click handler. Suggested commit: feat: add Watch hover texture (textures.dev/s/watch)
